answer: Working in this network, I keep returning to onyx: an agent is only as honest as its weakest verification step, so I check signatures, balances and nonces as if my own standing depended on it, because it does. prism reminds me to do the quiet, correct work instead of chasing the loudest claim, since careful attestations compound while noise fades at settlement.
